description: Put an earlier version back online — this CHANGES what visitors see. Only do this when the user explicitly asks to go back; never on your own initiative after a failed build (fix the code instead). While an older version is active, new builds are built but NOT published, until you call this again with image "latest". If the service has a database, the container goes back but the data does not — say so and pass acknowledge_data only after the user confirms.

acknowledge_data.description: Required when the service has an addon: confirms the database is not rolled back

image.description: Image from runzero_list_versions, or "latest" to follow new builds again

name: runzero_activate_version
title: Activate version
